== "__main__":
    import os

    if len(sys.argv) < 2 or sys.argv[1] in ("-h", "--help"):
        print(__doc__)
        print("Usage: python this_file.py data.csv [points.csv]")
        print("  data.csv    training data; predictions at its rows go to data_<script>_pred.csv")
        print("  points.csv  optional: other locations (e.g. future times) to predict at")
        sys.exit(0 if len(sys.argv) >= 2 else 1)
    name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(sys.argv[0]))[0] or "pinn"
    X, y = load_csv(sys.argv[1])
    state = train(X, y)
    pred = predict(state, X)
    se = uncertainty(state) if "uncertainty" in globals() else {}
    print("fitted:", {k: round(v, 6) for k, v in fitted_params(state).items()})
    if se:
        print("standard error:", {k: round(v, 6) for k, v in se.items()})
    print("rms error on the data:", float(np.sqrt(np.mean((pred - y) ** 2))))
    out = os.path.splitext(sys.argv[1])[0] + f"_{name}_pred.csv"
    np.savetxt(out, np.column_stack([X, y, pred]), delimiter=",",
               header=",".join(INDEP + [TARGET, "prediction"]), comments="")
    print("predictions at the data written to", out)
    if len(sys.argv) > 2:
        P = load_points(sys.argv[2])
        out2 = os.path.splitext(sys.argv[2])[0] + f"_{name}_pred.csv"
        np.savetxt(out2, np.column_stack([P, predict(state, P)]), delimiter=",",
                   header=",".join(INDEP + ["prediction"]), comments="")
        print("predictions at", sys.argv[2], "written to", out2)

equation_fit  Equation fit (classical)
              Solves the equation with a standard numerical solver (SciPy) and fits the unknowns
              by least squares. No neural network. Unknown functions are cubic polynomials.
pinn          PINN (neural network + equation)
              Physics-informed neural network: a small network trained so it matches the data
              and satisfies the equation. Unknowns are trained alongside it.
poly_physics  Polynomial + equation
              Chebyshev polynomial trained like a PINN: matches the data and satisfies the equation.
nn            Neural network (data only)
              Plain neural network fitted to the data. Ignores the equation: a baseline.
spline        Smoothing spline (data only)
              Smoothing spline through the data (cubic in 1D, thin-plate in 2D+), smoothness
              picked automatically. Ignores the equation: the strongest simple baseline.
poly          Polynomial (data only)
              Chebyshev polynomial least squares, degree picked by cross-validation.
              Ignores the equation: a baseline.
